central_operating_premise.root_question: What tools and techniques can one use to determine slop from a solution and when does it make a difference?
central_operating_premise.caveat_emptor: This repository is a personal engineering experiment and transparent forensic audit, not a commercial product or canonical standard.
central_operating_premise.legacy_test_dilemma: In legacy systems with myriad contributors, passing specs often prove only narrow isolated assertions rather than physical system correctness, reassuring us while shipping slop.
central_operating_premise.strawberry_paradox: An LLM cannot reliably count the Rs in Strawberry, yet constructs complex 10-harmonic DSP pipelines, creating an unprecedented scale of uncomprehended complexity.
central_operating_premise.devaluation_of_old_signals: Outer signals of competence (man pages, Mermaid diagrams, 100% CI badges, schemas) cost zero with AI and no longer guarantee depth. Relying on them is hazardous.
central_operating_premise.sovereign_verification: The only viable defense is checking the boundary where code collides with physical reality (phase integrity, vocal intelligibility, lip-sync keyframes, and lossless stream copy).
central_operating_premise.semantic_stickiness_trap: Side-comments casually keyed into a chat can enter the corpus, become stubbornly sticky, and get inflated into central themes. Discerning real engineering from associative model fixation is a critical discipline.
